::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jan [<i>illegible</i>] 1868  
**From:** Bedford Street [<i>illegible</i>]  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS.55387 (2): P. 907
:::

Dear Miss Yonge
Yesterday [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd) paid [£200](organizations/other_160.qmd) into [Hoare’s](organizations/other_169.qmd) in your a/c. [I](people/person_939.qmd) hope my not telling you before will have caused you no [*illegible*]

I am very sorry you do not like the [illustrations](organizations/other_167.qmd).[^1] It is now impossible to get fresh ones done, and pardon me saying I really like them. I hope you will get reconciled to them by and by

[*Rest of letter indecipherable as is the one, dated 22 January 1868, that follows*]

---

[^1]: These were presumably [Edward Armitage](people/person_60.qmd)'s illustrations for *The Pupils of St. John the Divine* in Macmillan's [Sunday Library](organizations/other_145.qmd) series.
